role: The HRV recovery-report PDF generator: defines the report style/section option set, the sleep/sleep-trend/vitals input structs, page config, the bundled ReportInputs, and generateReport() which renders page 1, the optional charts page and the optional deep-dive pages with UIGraphicsPDFRenderer.
types: PDFReportGenerator: class — owns Config + settingsProvider; extended by +Pages/+Helpers/+SectionForwarding/+Summary/+OvernightForwarding/+DeepDiveForwarding
PDFReportGenerator.ReportSections: struct (OptionSet) — 8 section bits, presets all/summaryPreset/sleepPreset, picker labels
PDFReportGenerator.SleepData: struct — night sleep figures for the report, built from Emuqu.SleepData
PDFReportGenerator.SleepTrendData: typealias of AnalysisSleepTrendInput — multi-night sleep averages + trend, built from HealthKitManager.SleepTrendStats
PDFReportGenerator.Config: struct — Letter page size, margins, fonts, three colours
PDFReportGenerator.VitalsData: struct — resp rate/SpO2/wrist temp deviation/RHR from RecoveryVitals
PDFReportGenerator.ReportInputs: struct — everything one render reads, including the merged training context, the session's frozen context and today's live load snapshot
PDFReportGenerator.ReportHealthContext: struct — the 8 health-context inputs grouped
toplevel: Config stored-property initialisers fix page size 612x792 (US Letter), 40pt margins, system fonts 22/14/11/10/8 and mono 9, primary blue (0.2,0.4,0.8), secondary green (0.3,0.7,0.4), accent red (0.9,0.3,0.3). VitalsData.wristTemperatureLacksBaseline defaults false. ReportSections conforms to OptionSet+Sendable. File-scope private helpers reportInputs/mergedTrainingContext/reportRendererFormat are listed as units.

units.does: Static computed list of (section bit, localized label, SF Symbol) for the seven toggleable sections (overnightStats, sleep, trainingLoad, vitals, scoreBreakdown, charts, deepDive); hrvSummary is deliberately absent. Rebuilt on every read so labels follow the live app language.
Formats totalSleepMinutes as localized hours+minutes via LocalizedDuration.hoursMinutes.
Maps deepSleepMinutes through LocalizedDuration.hoursMinutes; nil when deep sleep was not measured.
Memberwise initializer assigning all eight sleep fields (start/end default nil). Used by the static .empty value and tests.
Builds report SleepData from an optional Emuqu.SleepData: copies start/end, nightSleepMinutes as total, inBed, deep, REM, awake and measuredSleepEfficiency.

branches.effect: nil → self = .empty (all zeros/nil); non-nil → copies fields

units.does: Stores the page Config and a settings provider closure; the default closure reads AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager.settingsSnapshot each time it is called (age/sex/temperature unit for the report).
True when any vitals value is present: respiratory rate, SpO2, wrist-temperature deviation, a temperature reading without baseline, or resting HR. Gates the vitals sections in +Pages.
Memberwise initializer for VitalsData (wristTemperatureLacksBaseline stays false). Used by .empty and tests.

Builds VitalsData from optional RecoveryVitals: copies resp rate/baseline, SpO2/min, uses wristTemperatureDeviation as wristTemperature, sets wristTemperatureLacksBaseline when a raw reading exists but deviation is nil, copies RHR.

Public entry: renders the full HRV report PDF for a session and returns its Data. Requires an analysisResult; bundles the health context and inputs (artifact flags, merged live/frozen training context, the session's frozen context, and — for today's session only — the caller's live load snapshot for the advice gate and summary), creates a Letter UIGraphicsPDFRenderer with Emuqu document info, and draws all pages.

branches.effect: returns nil (no report; generateReportURL then returns nil and callers show no share sheet); otherwise renders and returns PDF Data

units.does: Draws page 1 always, page 2 (visualizations, for the session's series) only when charts are selected and raw RR data exists, then the deep-dive pages plus analysis summary only for comprehensive style with deepDive selected. Threads a running page number.

branches.cond: sections contains .charts AND hasRawData AND series non-nil (bound and passed to page 2)
branches.effect: true → draws the charts page (overnight HR, Poincaré, PSD, tachogram, quality, window); false → no page 2
true → deep-dive pages + analysis summary page; false → report ends after page 1/2

units.does: Draws a light-blue rounded box with an info emoji and the imported-data note (height grows with wrapped text, min 50pt) at yPosition+10; returns the y below the box +15 (the total importedDataNoteHeight reports, which the caller reserves with ensureSpace first).
Total vertical space drawImportedDataNote advances: 10 above + max(50, wrapped note height + 20) box + 15 below, at the page's content width.
Wrapped height (ceil) of the imported-data note at contentWidth - 50, the width it is drawn at.
Builds the imported-data caveat string: names the import source when the session has importedMetrics, otherwise a generic 'summary data only' line, in body font dark grey.

branches.effect: 'Imported from <source>. Raw RR data not available - visualizations omitted.'; else 'Summary data only. Raw RR intervals not available for visualization.'

units.does: Assembles ReportInputs: session.rrSeries as series, explicit flags else session.artifactFlags else [], hasRawData = series has points, the health context fields, the merged training context, the session's frozen context (trainingSnapshot ?? result.trainingContext), and — only when the session ended today — the caller's live load snapshot as adviceLiveLoad; style and sections.

branches.effect: flags ?? session.artifactFlags ?? [] — no production caller passes flags (generateReportURL omits it), so session flags are used, and an empty array when the session has none
hasRawData = false when no series; else true only if series.points non-empty
adviceLiveLoad is nil, so the summary and advice gate read the frozen load

units.does: Returns the training context the report renders: when a live load snapshot is supplied AND the session's end (else start) date is today, a new TrainingContext with live ATL/CTL/TSB and the frozen non-load fields; otherwise the frozen session context.

branches.cond: live snapshot is nil OR session date (endDate ?? startDate) is not today
branches.effect: returns frozen result.trainingContext unchanged (may be nil)
falls back to startDate for the today check

units.does: Returns a UIGraphicsPDFRendererFormat with document info creator/author 'Emuqu' and a localized title 'Recovery Report'.
